subject.title: ci(qa): reuse Matrix live workflow for releases

question: Should the Matrix QA migration stack land in dependency order with this reusable release-workflow change as stack 3?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it changes release-gate ownership and sits between two open dependent maintainer PRs, so final sequencing and release-path acceptance require the stack owner's explicit decision.

options.title: Land the ordered stack
options.body: Merge the scenario migration first, refresh and verify this exact head, land this workflow consolidation, and then review the cleanup PR.

options.title: Pause workflow consolidation
options.body: Keep the release workflow's direct Matrix job until maintainers are ready to adopt the complete QA Lab ownership stack.

recommendation.title: Land the ordered stack
recommendation.body: Merge the scenario migration first, refresh and verify this exact head, land this workflow consolidation, and then review the cleanup PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the active four-PR migration and has extensive merged QA and release-workflow history.
